**Root cause:** The reported crash happens in `CliRunner.invoke`'s `finally` block at `sys.stdout.flush()` (the exact line in the issue traceback). After a command runs, `echo_via_pager` (through its non-tty / "no external pager" fallback) may close the isolated stdout stream that `CliRunner` set up. When `invoke` then unconditionally calls `sys.stdout.flush()`/`sys.stderr.flush()` on that now-closed stream, Python raises `ValueError: I/O operation on closed file`. `CliRunner` records output at the OS-fd / BytesIO level (the fd-capture bytes are merged into `outstreams` *after* the flushes), so flushing a closed stream mid-cleanup should not abort the whole invocation.

The minimal, traceback-targeted hardening is in `src/click/testing.py`: don't let the final cleanup flush crash when a command has closed the isolated stream.
